entities.summary: Tatsumi Hijikata was a Japanese choreographer, and the founder of a genre of dance performance art called Butoh. By the late 1960s, he had begun to develop this dance form, which is highly choreographed with stylized gestures drawn from his childhood memories of his northern Japan home. It is this style which is most often associated with Butoh by Westerners. Tatsumi Hijikata was a authors & novelists from Akita (1928-03-09, Akita–1986-01-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
